chapter_title: Concerning the worn and torn apart Garments, or the tattered Clothes, or the Elements, the Cross, and the rest too.
chapter_note: The chapter has a clear hagiographic/Q&A frame (¶1–6) introducing a technical glossary, followed by a sustained core teaching block (¶7–15) defining successive names of the Light-soul/power by mapping each name to a specific cosmological function/state (Pillar of Glory, rulers/firmaments, three earths, Porter, three garments of wind/fire/water, bound Light in dry/moist, summons/obedience, vegetative life as ‘slain soul’, and final reunification). Despite the chapter-level ‘fatigue’ signal, the latter paragraphs remain cosmological/eschatological rather than institutional; the drop appears to be a vocabulary-list artifact rather than a genuine pastoral graft here.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Formulaic sitting/speaking scene (‘apostle… congregation… disciples’) is the Kephalaia dialogue frame.
Meta-textual ‘lesson… written in the scriptures’ and interrogative catalogue presented as a scripted Q&A prompt; functions as editorial introduction rather than expository cosmological mechanism.
Explicit appeal to ‘written and sealed… by a multitude of scriptures’ plus direct address (‘I ask you…’) continues the editorial Q&A scaffolding anchored in a scriptural archive.
Pure dialogue marker (‘His disciples say to him’)—container, not teaching.
Hagiographic praise/entreaty (‘source/fount of all wisdoms… we entreat you’) is stereotyped disciples’ frame speech.
Dialogue attribution with ‘apostle’ (and page marker) is an explicit compilation-frame seam; per rules, never part of substrate.

paragraphs.core_text: “It is proper for you to understand this. The garments that are named ‘great garment’ are the five intellectuals that make perfect the body of the Pillar of Glory, the Perfect Man. They were purified by the coming of the Ambassador.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Systematic internal mapping of a technical name (‘great garment’) to a defined cosmic structure (five intellectuals → body of the Pillar of Glory/Perfect Man) and a cosmological process (purified by the Ambassador).

paragraphs.core_text: “In contrast, the ones named ‘rag’: the rags are the devoured enlightening power. It is compounded and entangled in the body of the universe in the rulers who are above, who exist in all the firmaments. Also, its shine is that which lights up and is displayed in the stars of the chain and the powers of the course. And likewise, these rags that are entangled in these three earths below, above the head of the Porter [...] on the earth that is under the Porter. These are named the ‘rags’, because [...] set [...]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmos→cosmos definition: ‘rag’ mapped to the devoured Light-power distributed through rulers/firmaments, stellar manifestations, and the three earths around the Porter; no institutional or exhortatory application.

paragraphs.core_text: “However, the ‘great worn and torn apart garments’, which we have proclaimed, is this entangled living power. It is reaped, cut, and devoured. It is overpowered by the five worlds of the flesh, which creep as they move from place to place.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Mechanistic description of how the entangled Living power is processed/consumed by the five worlds of Flesh—internal cosmological dynamics stated as ‘what it is/undergoes’.

paragraphs.core_text: “On the other hand, [these] we have termed the ‘images and the great tattered clothes’ [...] are the three great garments of the wind, the fire, and the water. These the Living Spirit cloaked upon his body. With them he set in order things in the universe. With them also he emptied the vessels. He swept them out and laid them bare in front of the Porter at the foundation of all things.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Structured correspondential definition within the cosmic system (name → triad of garments → elements wind/fire/water → actions of the Living Spirit → cosmic ordering and emptying of vessels before the Porter).

paragraphs.core_text: “Conversely, ‘[the ele]ments’, we have called them this name, are this power that remains in all things below. It rises up in the wombs of all the earths, gathering together, and pouring forth upon all things.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Definition of ‘elements’ as the remaining Light-power below, described as an immanent process in the earths (‘wombs… gathering… pouring forth’); impersonal cosmological exposition.

paragraphs.core_text: “And then, the ‘[Light] Cross’ [we have termed] this bound ‘light power’. It [...] all [...] upon the earth, in the dry and the moist.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmic technical term (‘Light Cross’) defined as a state of bound Light-power diffused through terrestrial domains (dry/moist); not a Gospel citation despite ‘Cross’ terminology.

paragraphs.core_text: “Also, the one named the ‘counsel of life’ is the summons and the obedience. It moves in all these powers that we have named. It awakens them, gives them ease, and drives them to their movement.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Internal functional mapping: ‘counsel of life’ = summons/obedience operating as an activating principle within the previously named powers.

paragraphs.core_text: “The one named ‘the soul that is slain’, which is killed, oppressed and murdered; it is this power of fruit, vegetables and seeds. They shall be threshed, plucked and cut down; and they give nourishment to the worlds of the flesh. Further: the wood should it be dry, and the garment should it become ragged, will perish. Again, it is [a pa]rt of this entire soul that is slain and killed; since also even this whole part of it they kill [...]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmos-in-nature register: ‘slain soul’ mapped to Light-power in vegetation/agricultural processing that feeds the worlds of Flesh; still descriptive (what happens to the power) rather than moral exhortation.

paragraphs.core_text: “For all these names [...] are a single [...] since the beginning, it [...] as it enlightens; but they separated into all these parts in this first contest. They became set in all these altered forms, and these many names. Of course, if now all these varieties are laid bare, and stripped of all these appearances, and parted from all these names; they will gather together and make a single form, and a single name, unaltered and unchangeable for ever in the land of their first essence, from which they were sent forth against the enemy.”
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core synthetic closure: eschatological reunification of the one Light-power behind multiple functional names/forms; remains within the cosmic drama (‘first contest… sent forth against the enemy’), not church discipline.
